page.googleSiteVerificationHint:
Your store is already verified on store.force-ai.co — you only need this once you connect a custom domain (e.g. yourstore.com).
1. Open Google Search Console and add your custom domain as a URL-prefix property.
2. Pick the "HTML tag" verification method.
3. Paste the whole meta tag (or just the content token) here and save.
4. Click Verify in Search Console — your storefront will already be serving the tag.

new.title: New Stock Adjustment
new.description: Choose the adjustment type and set new quantities. Saving as draft lets you review before posting; posting is irreversible.
new.typeTip: cycle_count = routine recount correction; damage = damaged, unsellable; theft = lost to theft or shrinkage; loss = lost or misplaced (not theft or damage); write_off = deliberately removed (expired or obsolete); found = previously-missing stock located (increases quantity); return_to_supplier = sent back to supplier.
new.glJournalTip: GL journal = the accounting record (General Ledger). Posting auto-creates a balanced bookkeeping entry — e.g. a write-off debits a loss/expense account and credits inventory — keeping accounts accurate. Save as draft to review before it affects your books.

balanceDescriptions.title: Balance languages
balanceDescriptions.body: For each product, makes the English field English and the Arabic field Arabic — for the name AND the description. If both slots hold the same language it translates the missing one (Arabic is the source of truth); if a slot has the wrong language it is corrected.
balanceDescriptions.forceTooltip: Re-balance even products that already look correct (translate again).

revertBalance.title: Revert balance
revertBalance.body: Undo the last balance run — restores the original name and description fields (both languages) before balancing was applied.
revertBalance.forceTooltip: Restores the pre-balance originals even if fields were edited since.

fillMissingArabic.title: Fill missing Arabic
fillMissingArabic.body: Walks every product, category, and the store row. Translates the English value into Arabic only when the Arabic field is empty.

fillMissingEnglish.title: Fill missing English
fillMissingEnglish.body: Reverse direction. For every Arabic-only field, fills the English side. Skips already-bilingual entities.

seoMeta.title: Generate missing SEO meta
seoMeta.body: For the store row and every product, generates meta title + description in EN and AR when those fields are empty. Skips entities that already have SEO.
seoMeta.forceTooltip: Overwrites existing SEO meta on all entities.

recommendations.title: AI product recommendations
recommendations.body: Generate AI-driven cross-sell recommendations across your catalogue. Fills the storefront "You might also like" section on each product page. Re-running updates existing suggestions.
recommendations.forceTooltip: Re-generates recommendations for every product, replacing existing AI picks.

draftFaqs.title: Draft FAQs with AI
draftFaqs.body: Generates up to 8 store-level FAQ items covering delivery, payments, returns, product care, and more — bilingual (EN + AR). Skips questions a merchant has already edited.
draftFaqs.forceTooltip: Deletes all existing AI-drafted FAQs and regenerates from scratch. Manually-edited FAQs are preserved.

draftHowtos.title: Draft How-To Guides with AI
draftHowtos.body: Drafts up to 3 step-by-step HowTo guides relevant to the store's product mix (e.g. how to place an order, how to return an item). Bilingual EN + AR.
draftHowtos.forceTooltip: Deletes all existing AI-drafted HowTos and regenerates from scratch. Manually-edited guides are preserved.

metaAeo.title: Rewrite Meta Descriptions (AEO)
metaAeo.body: Rewrites empty store, product, and category meta descriptions in a conversational, direct-answer style suited for AI answer engines. Only fills blank AEO fields — never overwrites existing content.
metaAeo.forceTooltip: Overwrites existing AEO meta descriptions on all entities.

productFaqs.title: Draft Product FAQs with AI
productFaqs.body: Generates up to 5 bilingual (EN + AR) FAQ pairs for every product — the same drafting used by the per-product button, run across your whole catalogue. Skips products that already have FAQs.
productFaqs.forceTooltip: Re-drafts FAQs for every product, replacing AI-drafted FAQs. Manually-edited FAQs are preserved.

llmsTxt.title: Generate LLMs.txt
llmsTxt.body: Creates a /llms.txt file listing your store's categories, example product URLs, and key info. AI crawlers use this to understand your catalogue without scraping every page.
llmsTxt.forceTooltip: Overwrites existing LLMs.txt with a freshly generated version.

citationCopy.title: Product citation copy
citationCopy.body: Rewrites product descriptions in "definitive first sentence + key specs" format — the exact style AI assistants quote when answering product questions. Fills empty products only.
citationCopy.forceTooltip: Overwrites existing citation copy on all products.

brandFacts.title: Brand facts JSON
brandFacts.body: Generates structured brand facts (location, categories, languages, contact methods) as a JSON-LD Organization block. Emitted on every storefront page to improve AI knowledge-graph entries.
brandFacts.forceTooltip: Overwrites existing brand facts JSON with freshly generated data.

categorize.title: Assign categories
categorize.body: For every uncategorized product, picks the single best-matching category from your store's own category list — never invents a new one. Products that already have a category are always left alone.
categorize.forceTooltip: Categories are never reassigned once set — this sweep only ever fills products with zero categories.

imageAlt.title: Generate image alt-text
imageAlt.body: Uses Gemini Vision to write concise, descriptive alt-text (SEO + accessibility) for product images that don't have any yet. Checks up to 4 images per product to protect your AI quota.
imageAlt.forceTooltip: Images that already have alt-text are never overwritten — this sweep only fills images missing one.

excerpt.title: Draft product excerpts
excerpt.body: Summarises each product's full description into a punchy 1-2 sentence excerpt, bilingual EN + AR. Skips products that already have an excerpt.
excerpt.forceTooltip: Re-drafts excerpts the AI previously wrote. A manually-written excerpt is never overwritten.

productTags.title: Suggest product tags
productTags.body: Suggests up to 5 relevant tags per product from its name and description, reusing your store's existing tags wherever they fit. Skips products that already have at least one tag.
productTags.forceTooltip: Also tops up already-tagged products with newly-suggested tags (up to 5 total). Existing tags are never removed.

cards.defaultForceTooltip: Replaces existing content with a fresh AI generation.

masterSweep.aeoForceTooltip: Overwrites existing AEO content. Without this, sweeps skip entities that already have content.
masterSweep.geoForceTooltip: Overwrites existing GEO content. Without this, sweeps skip entities that already have content.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Manage two-factor authentication for your account
security.mfaBanner: Two-factor authentication is required for super-admin accounts. Set it up now to continue using the platform.
security.enableDescription: Protect your account by requiring a verification code in addition to your password.
security.scanDescription: Open your authenticator app and scan this QR code, or enter the setup key manually.
security.currentCodeLabel: Current verification code (required to change authenticator)
security.backupCodesDescription: Save these one-time backup codes in a safe place. Each code can only be used once. If you lose access to your authenticator app, you can use these to sign in.
security.disableDescription: You will need to enter your current verification code to disable 2FA.
security.disableConfirmDescription: This will remove the extra security layer from your account. You can re-enable it at any time.
security.errorBegin: Failed to start enrollment. Please try again.
security.errorVerify: Invalid code. Please check your authenticator app and try again.
security.successEnabled: 2FA has been enabled for your account.

page.title: Payment Abandonments
page.subtitle: Shoppers who reached the payment gateway but did not complete payment.
page.enterprise: Payment abandonment capture is an Enterprise feature.
page.empty: No gateway abandoners found in this period.
page.emptyHint: The sweep runs every 30 minutes and marks orders whose gateway link was generated but never paid.
page.retargetHint: Contact the customer via WhatsApp or phone to recover the sale.

page.title: WhatsApp Integration
page.subtitle: Force AI WhatsApp Business Platform · templates · order updates · payment links

connection.connectDescription: Paste the API key generated in your Force AI WhatsApp Business Platform admin to link this store.
connection.apiKeyHint: Generate the key in WBS admin → Clients → Force AI Store Bridge icon. Paste it here — the key is verified immediately.
connection.finishDescription: An API key is saved but WhatsApp notifications aren't enabled yet. Select your templates below and enable to activate.
connection.keyInvalid: The API key may be invalid. Template sending will fail — disconnect and re-key.
connection.cantVerify: Couldn't reach Force AI WhatsApp to verify this key. It's saved but unconfirmed — use Retry.
connection.notificationsDescription: Master switch for outbound WhatsApp messages. Per-event templates and channel choices live in the Order Updates tab.
connection.waOrderingDescription: When enabled, customers who DM the store's WhatsApp number can browse + order directly. The bot will guide them through delivery + payment, then a draft order lands here ready to fulfill.
connection.waOrderingNote: Default off — opt in when you're ready to handle bot-guided orders.
connection.toastInvalidKeyBody: The API key was rejected. Generate a new key in WBS admin.
connection.toastConnectFailedBody: Could not connect to Force AI WhatsApp
connection.toastConnectedAutoErr: Force AI WhatsApp connected — but template auto-submit failed: {error}. Visit Templates tab to retry.
connection.toastConnectedBody: Force AI WhatsApp Business Platform connected
connection.toastConnectFirstBody: Please connect a WBS API key before enabling notifications
connection.toastWaOnBody: Customers can now order directly via WhatsApp DM.
connection.toastWaOffBody: WhatsApp DM ordering has been turned off.
connection.toastWaSaveFailedBody: Could not update WA ordering setting

templates.noTemplatesHint: Click Generate defaults to add the 12 canonical Force AI templates as drafts.
templates.howItWorks: How it works: Click Generate defaults to create the canonical templates as drafts. Click Sync to Meta to submit them. Meta reviews each template; approval typically takes 10 minutes to 24 hours.
templates.logoLabel: Use my store logo as the WhatsApp message header
templates.logoHint: Customers see your store logo at the top of every order-update message. Applied when you next generate or sync templates.
templates.logoNoLogoWarning: Set a store logo first under Branding before enabling this.
templates.logoEnabledNote: On. Next sync will upload your logo to Meta and submit templates with image headers.
templates.toastLogoOnBody: Next template generation/sync will include your store logo as the message header image.
templates.toastLogoOffBody: Future templates will be generated without a header image.
templates.toastCreatedBody: Click Sync to submit them to Meta.
templates.toastAllSeededBody: All canonical templates are already seeded.
templates.toastSubmittedBody: Approval typically takes 10 minutes to 24 hours. Status will update automatically.
templates.toastAllSubmittedBody: All templates have already been submitted.
templates.toastResetBody: Templates flipped to draft with the latest canonical body. Click Sync to resubmit.
templates.toastNoRejectedBody: There are no rejected templates to reset.

orderUpdates.notConnectedHint: Connect to Force AI WhatsApp Business Platform first from the Connection tab, then come back here.
orderUpdates.templateNotFoundHint: Generate templates first from the Templates tab.
orderUpdates.bothOff: Both off — event will be silent
orderUpdates.howItWorks: How it works: when a customer's order transitions to one of these states, the FWB API fires the corresponding WhatsApp template via your Force WhatsApp Business Platform integration. Use the channel checkboxes to control which notification methods are active per event.

orderPaid.label: Order paid
orderPaid.description: Send automatically the moment a customer completes payment.

orderShipped.label: Order shipped
orderShipped.description: Send when the order is marked as shipped (includes tracking number variable).

orderDelivered.label: Order delivered
orderDelivered.description: Send when the order is marked as delivered.

cartAbandoned.label: Cart abandoned
cartAbandoned.description: Send a reminder when a customer leaves items in their cart without checking out. Up to 3 steps: 1 h, 4 h, 24 h after abandonment.

orderUpdates.languageHint: Templates with this language code must be approved by Meta.
orderUpdates.silentEventBody: {event} has both channels off — no notification will be sent.

paymentLink.description: Send a customer a one-tap WhatsApp payment link backed by a MyFatoorah invoice. Pick catalogue items, add a custom amount, or both — the customer taps once, lands on the MyFatoorah checkout, and pays. The link stays valid until the order is paid or canceled.
paymentLink.phoneError: Must start with + and be 8–16 digits.
paymentLink.searchProducts: Search {count} products by name or SKU…
paymentLink.customAmountHint: Add a charge that isn't a catalogue product — a custom quote, service fee, or deposit. Baked into the order total + reconciled when MyFatoorah callback returns.
paymentLink.sentDescription: Customer receives the WhatsApp message immediately. The MyFatoorah checkout link stays valid until the order is paid or canceled.
paymentLink.requirements: Requirements: the paymentLink template must be approved by Meta. Visit the Templates tab to generate and sync templates.
paymentLink.toastSentBody: {phone} will receive the MyFatoorah checkout link via WhatsApp.

botAnalytics.notConnected: WBS is not connected for this store. Configure the integration in the Connection tab first.
botAnalytics.noSessions: No sessions recorded in this date window yet.
botAnalytics.loadError: Could not load analytics. Please check your WBS connection.

botMode.title: Bot Mode
botMode.subtitle: Choose how the WhatsApp bot handles customer product browsing and ordering.
botMode.desc_legacy_chat: Customers browse and order via text messages. No Meta Commerce account required.
botMode.desc_native_catalog: WhatsApp opens your Meta Commerce catalog directly. Requires a configured Meta catalog ID below.
botMode.desc_native_catalog_with_gemini_agent: Native catalog + Gemini AI answers customer questions and assists with ordering.

serviceMenu.title: Service Menu
serviceMenu.subtitle: Choose which options appear when a customer first messages the bot.
serviceMenu.item_orderNow_desc: Opens the product catalog / ordering flow.
serviceMenu.item_locationsHours_desc: Sends store address, Google Maps link, and business hours.
serviceMenu.item_chatWithAgent_desc: Hands conversation off to a human team member.

metaCatalog.title: Meta Commerce Catalog
metaCatalog.subtitle: Required for Native Catalog bot modes. Find these IDs in your Meta Business Manager.
metaCatalog.catalogIdHint: From Meta Commerce Manager → Catalog Settings.
metaCatalog.businessIdHint: From Meta Business Manager → Business Settings → Business Info.
metaCatalog.accessTokenPlaceholderRotate: Type a new token to rotate it
metaCatalog.accessTokenHint: Create a System User in Meta Business Manager → grant catalog_management permission. Token is encrypted at rest and never shown again after saving.
metaCatalog.provisionDescription: Creates a new Commerce Catalog under the Force AI parent Business Manager and fills in the three fields above. Saves the merchant from navigating Meta Business Manager. You still need to submit the catalog for Meta review afterwards.
metaCatalog.saveError: Failed to save Meta catalog config
metaCatalog.provisionSuccess: Meta catalog provisioned — submit it for Meta review next.
metaCatalog.confirmAlready: A catalog id is already filled in. Clear it first if you really want to provision a new one. Continue anyway?
metaCatalog.confirmNew: This will call Meta Graph API to create a brand-new Commerce Catalog under the Force AI parent Business Manager and assign it to this store. Continue?
